title: WP-D1…WP-D3 of the DASHBOARD build pack: BP-DASH-MONITOR-001 own state, vocabulary and projections with the verify:domain-boundaries gate (CTG-0001); alert cycle, duties, freshness, dashboard-owned clock, export with cell suppression, reports, audit trail, open data, SSE, command contracts, event schemas, feed proposals and documentation (CTG-0002)

batches.headline: Delivered WP-D1: BP-DASH-MONITOR-001 1.0.0 (20 entities, no routes), DDL 19-dashboard-lifecycle-vocabulary.sql (10 refs, 14 timers owner=dashboard), @detran/dashboard-monitor with 8 projectors declaring consumedEvents, catalogue seed (42 indicators P3, 15 duties) and state fixtures, generalized verify:domain-boundaries gate wired into pnpm check, DASHBOARD block in check-lifecycle-vocabulary, parameters verifier recognising consumedEvents, portal projections declaring consumedEvents (PR #83).

Delivered WP-D2/WP-D3 via M7/A3 (Owner amendment 2): blueprint 1.1.0 (Timer, AccessLog, 7 handwritten controllers), escalation_chain_ref, dashboard-owned clock/sweeper, alert cycle with 13 guarded transitions, duties, freshness, layer gate (N3 never, X-Purpose, access_log), export with primary/secondary suppression and watermark, reports/catalogue/panels, audit trail/comparisons/transparency/kpis, datasets/open-data, SSE /v1/dashboard/stream, commands contract (43 ops) and 6 event schemas, 4 feed proposals, check-commands gate extended (203 ops), and documentation of WP-D1…D3 with OD-D14…D80 (PR #87).
